name: data-science-python-playground
description: Shared web source and Capacitor shell for Data Science Python Playground.

scripts.build:ios-assets: npm run vendor:pyodide && DSPP_NATIVE_RUNTIME=1 node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && python3 -m http.server 8000 -d dist
scripts.check: npm run build:web && npm run check:js && npm run check:routes && npm run check:app-shell
scripts.check:js: node --check home.js && node --check ml-app.js && node --check app/app-platform.js
scripts.check:routes: node tests/test_ml_state.mjs && node tests/test_ml_teaching.mjs && node tests/test_ml_practice_final.mjs && python3 tests/test_ml_routes.py
scripts.ios:add: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:ios-assets && npx cap sync ios
